title: lathyroides
intro: Lathyroides, commonly known as Lathyrus, is a genus of flowering plants in the pea family, Fabaceae. The health benefits of Lathyroides include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and have antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and its application in traditional medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
